name: Hong Kong International Airport
direct_access_note: 15 pages captured first-hand on desktop and iPhone 14 emulation plus three interaction scripts. One page (shop directory) returned a Cloudflare challenge once and was not retried beyond a sibling page. Blocked by the container, not site defects: analytics, the map data host (hkia-cdn.starbeacon.io), the live car park feed (zcarp-blob.hkairport.com); the chatbot window did not open. E-shop, booking platform and rewards site not reachable. Scores are expert judgements, not instrumented tests.

evidence: [direct] Coherent blue/teal system and consistent components on all 13 pages captured, but condensed type, angled hero masks and a three-slide carousel date the design: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/
[direct] Flight status values are plain black text with no colour, pill or icon hierarchy: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/flights/departures/passenger.page
[direct] Homepage hero carries a slogan ("WHERE AMAZING JOURNEYS BEGIN") rather than a task; flight panel is a small overlay bottom-right
Expert assessment from desktop and mobile screenshots; competent, not a reference design
[direct] Arrivals and Departures one click from the homepage hero panel: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/
[direct] Site search doubles as flight search: typing "CX 257" suggests "CX 257 (Depart: 17 Nov 2026)" and opens a live flight card
[direct] Check-in aisle, transfer desk, gate, arrival hall and belt link straight to map anchors (e.g. /en/map/index.page#gate_069)
[direct] Bookmarked flights persist without login (cookie HKIA.flight-bookmark) and show in the header of every page
[direct] Negatives: mobile first screen is app banner + notice (dated 2026-03-30) + hero; table rows are not clickable; flight card has no URL of its own
3 interactions from homepage to one flight's status by either route
[direct] Nine fields per departure incl. terminal, check-in aisle, transfer desk, gate; arrivals add parking stand, hall, belt: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/flights/arrivals/passenger.page
[direct] Transfer guide with separate step sequences for with/without onward boarding pass: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/passenger-guide/transfer-transit/

[direct] Parking has nine sub-pages (availability, charges, booking, online payment, valet, EV, HZMB, automated car parks): https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/transport/parking/space-availability.page
[direct] Special-needs content filterable by journey stage and by type of need: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/passenger-guide/airport-facilities-services/special-needs-access
[direct] Dining directory with gate-relative locations and opening hours: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/shop-dine/dining/
[direct] Deduction: stale items in prominent places ("Latest updates on COVID-19" in main menu; March 2026 notice pinned in November)
[direct] "Last updated on: 17 Nov 2026, 07:58 HKT" with refresh control; feed returns lastUpdatedTime: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/flights/departures/passenger.page
[direct] Filters: keyword (flight number / destination / airline), date picker, two-hour time bands, Passenger/Cargo tabs, Load Earlier Flights
[direct] Codeshares grouped in one row; status vocabulary Boarding Soon / Boarding / Final Call / Gate Closed / Dep HH:MM / Est at HH:MM / Landed HH:MM / At gate HH:MM
[direct] Login-free bookmark per flight with header counter; search suggests flights for today and tomorrow; live card shows airline phone and lounge link
[direct] Not a 5: no status colour coding, no flight detail URL, no web alerts (boarding alerts are app-only), no wait-time or walking-time context
[direct, described not tested] App adds boarding alerts and MyTAG baggage arrival notice: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/flights/MyHKG-mobile-app/
[direct] No horizontal overflow on any of 13 pages captured in iPhone 14 emulation
[direct] Flight table reflows to labelled cards with map pins; menu shows six sections at 65 px row height
[direct] Negatives: viewport meta disables zoom (axe meta-viewport on every page); target-size flagged on 19 nodes of the flight list; app banner + notice consume about 45% of the first screen
[direct, lab] Lighthouse mobile median performance 28, LCP 8.9 s, TBT 2,454 ms (lab, single container, third-party hosts blocked, indicative only)
[search] My HKG app rated about 3.6/5 from ~1.4K ratings on the Hong Kong App Store: https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/id1488720261
[direct] Six primary labels (Flights, Passenger Guide, Transport, Shop & Dine, Relax & Fun, Map), breadcrumbs and local nav on every page
[direct] Keyboard: three skip links first, browser-default focus outline visible on all 12 stops, logical order: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/
[direct] Text-size control (A/A+/A++), sitemap, accessibility statement citing Triple Gold 2020: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/accessibility-statement.page
[direct] Search: "prayer room" returns 4 results with the right page first; "parking" returns Space Availability first; category tabs
[direct] Negatives: axe home 8 rules desktop and mobile (4 critical ARIA structure failures), 3 critical on every page tested, no main landmark, unlabelled time-band select
[direct] Web personalisation limited to login-free flight bookmarks and remembered text size/notice state; no account or dashboard on the website
[direct, limited] Chatbot launcher (#aahk-chatbot-launcher) on every page; its window did not open in this container so quality is unassessed
[direct, described not tested] App chatbot, boarding alerts, AR wayfinding, rewards account: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/flights/MyHKG-mobile-app/
[search] Generative AI Virtual Assistant tender awarded 12 June 2025: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/airport-authority/tender-notices/PRO_T292_25_NC_Award (link to the web chatbot not confirmed)

[direct] HKairport Rewards: points on merchant, e-shop, food-ordering and automated car park spend; HKIA Dollar and coupons; QR membership at checkout: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/shop-dine/hkairport-rewards.page
[direct link, not visited] E-shop HKairportShop.com in the primary menu; one-stop services booking platform https://www.hkairportbooking.com/en/ (meet and assist, VIP lounge, baggage)
[direct] Car park booking, online payment, valet and automated car parks: https://www.hongkongairport.com/en/transport/parking/car-park-booking.page
Transaction flows not tested (hosts outside reach); shop directory page returned a Cloudflare challenge once
[direct, lab] Homepage desktop TTFB 163 ms, FCP 0.67 s, load 3.75 s, 57 requests, 1.88 MB; inner pages FCP 1.6-2.6 s (lab, single container, third-party hosts blocked, indicative only)
[direct, lab] Lighthouse mobile median: performance 28, accessibility 68, best practices 50, SEO 83, LCP 8.9 s, TBT 2,454 ms, CLS 0.184
[direct] HSTS with preload, nosniff, x-frame-options sameorigin; no content-security-policy header returned; Cloudflare with 5-minute cache
[direct] One transient Cloudflare 403 challenge in about 30 loads; live parking and map data depend on extra hosts

steps_note: Route A: click search box, type flight number, pick suggestion. Route B: click Departures, type in filter, press Enter.

axe.note: axe-core WCAG A/AA rules, automated only; not a conformance audit

keyboard.note: Three skip links; browser-default outline on all 12 stops; two notice-bar stops were scrolled out of view when focused

performance_lab.label: lab, single container, third-party hosts blocked, indicative only

standouts.name: Flight board with operational depth and map deep links
standouts.why: Check-in aisle, transfer desk, gate, stand, hall and belt per flight, each linked to its map location, with a visible last-updated stamp

standouts.name: Login-free flight bookmarking in the global header
standouts.why: One tap to save a flight, counter visible on every page, no account needed

standouts.name: One search box for content and flights
standouts.why: Flight-number suggestions for today and tomorrow, screen-reader announcements, live flight card

standouts.name: Special-needs guide on two axes
standouts.why: Filter by journey stage and by type of need; ACI Level 3 and Sunflower membership stated

standouts.name: Parking product family tied to loyalty
standouts.why: Availability, booking, online payment, valet, EV, automated car parks, with reward points on parking spend

weaknesses: Flight status is undifferentiated black text; urgent states do not stand out
No flight detail URL: the live card cannot be shared, bookmarked in the browser or indexed
Personal features (alerts, rewards, baggage notice, wayfinding) require the app; no web account
Accessibility drift: critical ARIA failures on every page, no main landmark, zoom disabled on mobile
Mobile first screen dominated by app banner, notice and hero; mobile lab performance 28; stale content in prominent places
ideas: Permanent shareable flight pages with colour and icon status, gate walking time and web push or WhatsApp alerts without an app
Turn a login-free saved flight into a homepage 'My journey' strip: terminal, counter, time to leave, transport and parking for that flight
Answer facility searches directly with nearest location, level, hours and map link
Compare ground transport modes in one view (time, cost, first/last service, step-free) with deep links to booking
Maintain accessibility in the build: main landmark, zoom allowed, automated checks, dated statement
Mobile-first homepage with flight search in the first 300 px and a performance budget (mobile LCP under 2.5 s)
gaps: Interactive map routing, walking times and accessible routes not assessed (map data host blocked)
Live car park numbers not seen (feed host blocked)
Chatbot conversation not assessed (window did not open)
E-shop, booking platform and rewards transaction flows not tested
App features are as described by the airport, not tested
